notes.title: First update for Prologue version 🥳
notes.content:
Hello My Museum funs

Thanks to feedback from you, we are updating the prologue. Admittedly, the new version does not yet solve all the problems you have reported, but we are working up a sweat to give you another update soon. Among other things, with the introduction of a game save option. For now we give you...

Fixes:
- Changed 'trash' icon from barrels to trash collection
- The cleaning of Ngal's sword has been improved
- Improved cleaning of MP40 items
- A collection of smaller fixes in the workshop
- Torch riddle fixes (slashes)
- Added missing translations

News:
- Ability to automatically clean an item when it reaches 75% (at a premium)
- Added ability to clean an item after reaching a set "100%

PS if you gave a negative review, and this update will fix the problems you encountered, please change your review.
Greetings ManyDev Studio team

notes.title: 🥳 Great News for all My Museum funs 🏛️
notes.content:
Hello My Museum funs :)
Thank you for participating in the Playtests👏, and for filling out the surveys. Your votes will not go in vain. Expeditions received the most votes for the most expect game expansion in February. As you expected, we added it to the game, it is the Ancient Pyramid of Egypt🏜️, and as it turned out, it was a shot in the arm, as this element of the game was the best rated during the last Playtest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/f95a2114b6b32c8f2801bb009b31dd17bca52f02.png

What's more, we gave you a choice of what places the next expedition would go to. The winner in this category was a World War II bunker. 🥳 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/6c2673f8deabf512aecd8b9134c5983104c57841.png

It is the bunker that will appear as another place of exploration, it will be a mysterious location containing interesting puzzles and artifacts that we will acquire for our museum.
We have prepared for you a short video from the bunker.

[previewyoutube=bDLKTUlVN1U;full][/previewyoutube]

MOREOVER YOU CAN EXPECT PROLOGUE VERSIO  IN NEXT MONTH. STAY TUNED

notes.title: DevLog #1 Prologue Teaser
notes.content:
Dear treasure Hunters!

In response to the community feedback, we decided to add an Expedition mode. New feature will be included in My Museum Prologue. The Expedition mode will allow you to discover many mysterious places in the world. Fasten your seatbelts, ancient artefacts are waiting for you!

What can you expect?

 Ancient Egyptian Architecture - tombs!
 Riddles of the Egyptian Pyramids
 Priceless Artifacts
 More renovator handwork!
 Mummies (Cats too)!


Get ready for an exciting adventure!
